metadata.name: Test Circuit with Bus References
metadata.description: Switch connected to GPIO with external pull-down resistor using bus references.

wires.description: Wire from Pico GPIO 16 to Breadboard the 9th Bus with holes A-D. This wire is for high/low measurement.
Wire from Pico 3.3V pin to Breadboard the 2nd Bus with holes A-D. This wire connects the switch to 3.3V.
Wire from Pico ground pin to Breadboard the 9th Bus with holes A-D. This wire connects the pulldown resistor to ground.
